★Request
Fade in from black

So, to you, the way I ran...
looked "like magic," right?

You're supposed to be my familiar!! Yet you go and faint on your own!!
You startled me half to death!! And you wouldn't even answer me!!

Huuuh?! I was NOT worried!!
I'm mad!! I am super, mega mad at you!!
Lizard☆Fish☆Chameleon!!
Huh?

You're still my familiar from now on!
You have to help me forever and ever, got it?!

...I even brewed three giant plastic bottles full of dokudami tea
and packed your whole fridge with them, so there.

...Hey, you asked me before,
"Don't you want to see a wider world of racing?"
I see. ...So that's how it is.
...Humph. Well, as long as you understand!!

Fine, I've decided. I'll give running a shot.
I'll run for you.
Yeah. That actually sounds—a little bit fun.

Sweets first, obviously! Today we're having scones.
I used to eat them all the time with Grandma. Nothing boosts your mood better!

Luck, talent, and sheer skill. Seizing complete victory on a once-in-a-lifetime stage
that remains out of reach unless you possess all three and are chosen by destiny—

Understood?
...If you get it, say something!!

...Hey, you asked me before,
"Don't you want to see a wider world of racing?"

After all, beyond the "fun" of running on my own terms,
maybe there really is magic waiting for me. ...Right?
Be that as it may, young though she was, she was still an Umamusume—and her grip was so tight that it honestly made my spine creak, but—

...You better eat properly too, okay?!
Stuff yourself full so you don't go passing out again!

Her potential was truly second to none.
From here on out, we'd polish it together as a team—!
Sweep Tosho grumbled in a huff. Even so, I couldn't help but feel that just beneath the surface of her voice lay an equal measure of genuine concern.

Seriously, are you an IDIOT?!
You're a hundred years too early to go making your magical girl worry like that!!

No! Don't move!
I don't care if it hurts! Just bear with it, dummy!!

I guess I can believe what my familiar says.
...After all, I'm a generous and open-minded genius magical girl♪

Hey, familiar... You know,
when I beat everyone in that race the other day, it actually felt kinda nice.

Got that?! I won't forgive you unless you drink every last drop!!
I'm gonna come check on you, so you better believe it!!
Gaaahhh... HE WOKE UUUP...!!

What's that supposed to mean? Why do you think we'll find magic out there?
...Tell me more. In detail.
Imagine? Imagine what?
Back when we first met, too. I got so annoyed with you bossing me around that I ignored you and just ran however I wanted... and it felt a little nice.
—I'm going to the Twinkle Series to search for magic!
Ah... You're awake.

Take two handfuls of chameleon plant... grind them up before they dry out...
Um, and then, the reviving spell is...!
I thought... maybe running because *I* decided to run... could actually be fun.

It felt nice. Just a little, a tiny little bit...
I thought it might be fun.
Rubbing the small back clinging to me, the situation clicked into place: I had collapsed, been carried here... and had a mountain of chameleon plant shoved down my throat to wake me up.
In an instant, an unbearable stench shot from my mouth straight through my nose, jolting me wide awake!
...*sniffle*
...Hmph.
...Or so I thought.
Surrounded by the roar of the frenzied crowd, kicking up the manicured turf over and over. Ahead, rivals overflowing with fighting spirit. The race growing hotter by the second.
She had finally decided to run on her own terms...! Swallowing back tears of emotion, I braced myself with renewed determination.

The following weekend, I brought Sweep Tosho along to visit Kyoto Racecourse.
The stands were overflowing with spectators eagerly awaiting the start of the big race.
A few days later, at training time. Facing Sweep Tosho, I braced myself for whatever selfish demand she might throw my way today, but—
